declaredOptions.label: Entry HTML file
declaredOptions.description: HTML file the game starts from when no execFile is set; defaults to index.html (RunActivity.java:55).

declaredOptions.label: Allow network access
declaredOptions.description: Lets the game load http and https resources; off keeps it entirely offline (RunActivity.java:70).

declaredOptions.label: Web contents debugging
declaredOptions.description: Exposes the game to Chrome's remote debugger; for diagnosing a game that will not start (RunActivity.java:71).

declaredOptions.label: DOM storage
declaredOptions.description: Enables localStorage, which most MV and MZ games save into (RunActivity.java:91).

declaredOptions.label: Web SQL database
declaredOptions.description: Enables the WebView database used by some older MV plugins (RunActivity.java:92).

declaredOptions.label: Require a tap before audio
declaredOptions.description: When on, audio and video only start after the player touches the screen (RunActivity.java:93).

declaredOptions.label: User agent string
declaredOptions.description: Overrides the browser identity the game sees; a few games branch on it (RunActivity.java:99).
